$comment: Flag registry. Each flag answers 'is this feature enabled?'. type: release (needs expires, <=60 days after created) | kill-switch (default true, permanent) | ops. Runtime override: env FLAG_<UPPER_SNAKE> locally; ops workflow remotely. See docs/feature-flags.md.

new-orders.description: Kill switch for trading: when off, the bot places no new orders (existing positions are left alone; closing them is an owner action). The ops workflow's kill action turns it off.
